angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 489,077 km at 77.70 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 12.8703 +/- 0.0165 mas (same row, RUWE 0.84): 77.70 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.703 +/- 0.024 solar radii from Rodriguez et al. 2018, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-266 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..245R/abstract): 489,077 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.686 +/- 0.033 solar masses from Rodriguez et al. 2018, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-266 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..245R/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4285 +/- 49 K from Rodriguez et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-266 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..245R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Rodriguez et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-266 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..245R/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-266.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.580, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-266 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.12 dex, from Rodriguez et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..245R/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-266 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.82333, from Rodriguez et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..245R/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 3855246074629979264, flags_flame 00: age_flame 10.562985 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 7.7862673 to 13.398531)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, K2-266: projected rotation speed 1.66 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2023A&A...676A..90R)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
